speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Eat before the bell. The loaf is shrunk on the pan, the price is a penny, and I will hear no speech on it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I was looking for the butter, not for an argument.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The butter is at your elbow, sir. You are looking at the empty side.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I cut mine as I cut it yesterday. No smaller. The wheat is the same wheat.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then cut it and be done. Alse, the rushes will be green. Do not bring them home on your skirt.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I never bring them, mistress. I only look, and then I stand up.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Lay no place for me at noon. I am looked for in Blackfriars. The shop is shut, and there is a dinner.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then the stair is mine till you remember whose it is. Come back before the close is dark.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I will sit at the back, if the mistress allows it. I like the rushes. They smell of a clean floor.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Sit where you sat at Easter. Do not make a new habit on a feast day.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will be in before dark. That is the whole of my promise.
